description: 경기도_상시교통량(일반국도 차종별) [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 경기도. 기도내 고속국도 및 일반국도의 지점별로 조사된 상시교통량을 1년 365일 차종별/방향별로 1일 교통량을 제공합니다. Coverage: 경기도. The portal files it under the publisher 경기도. Its tags are 차종별교통량, 국도교통량, 차량흐름, 교통량분석, 차량유형. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-06-19 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
